changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'OpenIdRequest') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[OpenIdRequest]( [State] [varchar](5) not null, [Nonce] [varchar](5) not null, [RedirectUrl] [varchar](2000) not null, [CreatedOn] datetime constraint DF_OpenIdRequest_CreatedOn default(getutcdate()) not null, CONSTRAINT [PK_OpenIdRequest] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [State] ASC ) ) END
if not exists (select 1 from information_schema.[columns] where table_Schema= 'dbo' and table_name = 'OpenIdRequest' and column_name = 'CreatedOn') begin alter table dbo.OpenIdRequest add [CreatedOn] datetime constraint DF_OpenIdRequest_CreatedOn default(getutcdate()) not null; end
